text.title: plan.md Structure Procedure
text.summary: Five steps: decide whether the feature is trivial, write `## Design`, write `## Execution Plan`, cross-reference with in-file anchors, and keep it one file as it grows.

step.name: decide-trivial-or-not
step.input: The feature's spec.md and its task list; the feature folder in `features/todo/` or `features/in-progress/`.
step.action: Count the tasks and look for any new contract, schema or sequencing constraint. Trivial means ≤3 tasks AND no new contract: the spec.md task checklist is the plan. Otherwise plan.md is required. If you cannot answer "is this trivial?" in one sentence, the answer is no.
step.output: skipped = true with a one-sentence reason, or a commitment to write plan.md.
step.decision-gate: Documentation-only feature or a CR / BUG — wrong lifecycle, stop (rule skip-this-methodology). Trivial — stop with the reason recorded (rule r-skip-when-trivial). Unsure — write it (rule r-when-in-doubt-write).

step.name: write-design
step.input: spec.md; project-spec/ for the system-wide contracts that must NOT be restated.
step.action: Write `## Design` covering: package / module layout — which dirs the feature creates or modifies; API contracts new to this feature — request/response shape, status codes, errors; schemas — DB tables, JSON shapes, message-queue payloads; sequencing — any ordering constraint (must run after migration X, must precede deploy of Y); trade-offs considered — one paragraph per non-obvious decision.
step.decision-gate: A contract that is system-wide belongs in project-spec/, not here (rule r-design-section-contents).

step.name: write-execution-plan
step.action: Write `## Execution Plan` containing: wave map — which tasks can run in parallel, which must serialize; task table — `T0N` id, one-line description, dependencies, token estimate; risks — known unknowns with mitigation; rollback — how to undo this feature if it must be reverted. See the worked table in 05-examples.
step.output: The `## Execution Plan` H2 of plan.md.
step.decision-gate: Every task has an id and a deps entry, or the executor cannot parallelise or resume (rule r-execution-plan-contents).

step.name: cross-reference-in-file
step.action: Where the Execution Plan depends on a Design decision (or vice versa), link with markdown anchors within plan.md. No separate file headers, frontmatter or version numbers per section.
step.output: plan.md with exactly two H2 sections and in-file anchors.
step.decision-gate: Any cross-file link means the two-file shape crept back (rules r-two-h2-mandatory, r-internal-anchors).

step.name: keep-it-one-file
step.action: When a decision changes, update plan.md — one file, one atomic change. If the file grows long, split internally by sub-section (`### Waves`, `### Tasks`, …), never into design.md + implementation-plan.md.
step.output: A plan.md that stays the single source for both design and execution until the feature reaches done/.
step.decision-gate: Two-file design + impl-plan is forbidden going forward (rules r-single-file-only, r-split-by-subsection-not-file).

list.item: The record validates against the schema in 02-output-contract.xml (plan present, or trivial skip with a reason).
`## Design` and `## Execution Plan` are both present and complete.
Readiness gate can verify every `T0N` task is done before the feature moves to done/.
No forbidden pattern matches; the decision tree (06) has been honoured.
